objective: Falsify the transferable claim that content-aware compression can be admitted into an F2 ContextView without losing exact omitted-original recoverability, provenance identity, deterministic boundary behavior, or fail-closed handling of missing recovery material.
counterhypothesis: Compression/reconstruction may be lossy or provider/model dependent, may hide evidence needed later, or may require a mutable auxiliary store that would become a second truth authority.
intended_discriminator: Source-bind the upstream recovery mechanism and run a bounded deterministic local fixture over synthetic evidence packets: verify byte-exact recovery where the mechanism claims reversibility; verify missing/mismatched recovery references fail closed; measure representation reduction only as component data, never as whole-system gain.
